report.summary: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and deep reinforcement learning algorithms has catalyzed a paradigm shift, transitioning artificial intelligence from isolated, human-directed tools into autonomous entities capable of sustained interaction within decentralized digital environments1.…
